card.name: Linking words in arrhythmia and QT lists
card.fires_on: Commas and linking words like "or" and "including" right after ventricular arrhythmia or torsades de pointes terms in QT-prolongation warnings. It also fires on a few other list-joining spots.

modes.label: Link after arrhythmia term
modes.description: A comma, "or" or "including" follows a ventricular arrhythmia or torsades term and leads into another rhythm term.
modes.example: Ventricular arrhythmias<< including>> torsade de pointes because QT prolong

modes.label: Comma after torsades
modes.description: A comma after Torsades de Pointes in a list of risk conditions.
modes.example: Torsades de Pointes<<,>> polymorphic ventricular tachycard

card.plain: It marks the small joining word or comma inside lists of dangerous heart rhythm problems in QT warnings.
